findings.message: LoadProfile now discards the error from FindByEmail and immediately dereferences u (u.Name). If FindByEmail returns an error with a nil *User, this panics; even on success-path errors it silently drops failures instead of returning them to callers.
findings.suggestion: Restore error handling: u, err := s.FindByEmail(email); if err != nil { return Profile{}, fmt.Errorf("load profile for %q: %w", email, err) } and only then build the Profile.
